Jordan (Sales): Hey team — Lyra (fintech analytics startup) wants a bespoke rate for their POC -> dedicated migration. Asking for 37% off list for a 12mo commit, target go-live in Q2. Need deal-desk approval by EOD Thurs so sales can lock pricing to their procurement timeline.
Maria (RevOps): Can you drop ACV / ARR and churn risk? 37% is above normal band.
Jordan (Sales): ACV estimate = ~$520k (see calc below). They commit to start at ~$45k/mo usage once dedicated. Reason for steep discount: heavy steady throughput, private deploy (VPC), and potential for multi-region expansion.
Jordan (Sales): ```
List math (rough):
- List token cost + infra premiums -> ~ $69,000/mo
- Requested 37% off -> $43,470/mo
- 12mo commit -> ACV ~ $521,640
- Add-on: private deployment + KMS + audit logs -> +$6,000/mo
```
Sam (Eng Presales): Technical note: they need 8x A100-class reserved for latency-sensitive scoring, KV cache persisted across restarts, and strict private networking (VPC peering). Those add operational cost; helps justify discount if we commit capacity.
Alex (Customer Success): POC success criteria we agreed on: tail latency <= 150ms, sustained 500 rps, and error rate < 0.2%. If POC hits that in 4 weeks, they convert to dedicated. Include that in SOW.
Kim (Deals Desk): 37% pushes this to VP-level approval and likely CRO sign-off. Also need to know payment terms, legal concessions, and whether we can offer a ramp credit vs up-front commit.
PricingBot: Auto-note: discounts >30% require RevOps + CRO approval and must be tied to a minimum committed ACV and payment cadence. Include expected ROI justification and competitive intel.
Maria (RevOps): Jordan — please add: 1) competitive logos/benchmarks 2) churn mitigation plan 3) payment cadence (monthly vs quarterly vs annual). Also propose a fallback tier: approve 25% now, escalate remaining 12% if POC meets stretch metrics.
Jordan (Sales): We prefer 12mo quarterly billing. If we do fallback: suggest 25% baseline + 12% NRR credit applied after conversion if they hit stretch metrics (>=700 rps sustained).
Kim (Deals Desk): Need exact contract language ask. Also list of legal exceptions (data residency, IP carveouts?). If present, approval is harder.
Sam (Eng Presales): They'll require SOC2 + encryption-in-flight + KMS integration. Legal asked about SLA 99.9% and credits. Those are doable but impact price.
Alex (Customer Success): I'll own the SOW acceptance criteria and post-POC handoff. Jordan, loop me into customer comms and share the POC runbook.
Maria (RevOps): I'm okay to provisionally approve up to 30% discount if: (a) single region private deploy, (b) 12mo commit, (c) quarterly billing, (d) CRO sign-off queued. For >30% (i.e., 37%) we need CRO approval + deal desk write-up with technical justification and legal redlines.
Jordan (Sales): Understood. Deadline: need a response by Thu EOD to hit their procurement window. I'll prepare the deal write-up and legal exception list.
Kim (Deals Desk): I'll queue this for CRO review. Jordan, send the write-up by 10am tomorrow. If we get CRO ok, RevOps will finalize the discount profile.
PricingBot: Checklist added to thread: [Deal write-up] [ACV calc] [Legal exceptions] [POC success criteria] [Payment terms].
Jordan (Sales): Thanks — I'll post the write-up here and tag you all.
Alex (Customer Success): One more ask — include a minimal rollback plan for them (auto-fallback to hosted model) in case private infra delays impact go-live.
Sam (Eng Presales): I'll include the infra spec and a quick ops runbook.
Kim (Deals Desk): Good. If CRO signs off, we'll document concessions in the DD spreadsheet and require a 25% non-refundable ramp credit if they cancel early.
Maria (RevOps): Final note: prefer to avoid multi-year rebates; keep it 12mo commit. Approvals contingent on CRO and legal.
Jordan (Sales): Copy. Writing up now and will ping at 09:45 PT with the packet. :thumbsup:
